# The Lean Sculpt Lab

> The Lean Sculpt Lab is a physician-led weight loss and body sculpting clinic in Collingwood, Ontario, Canada, serving South Georgian Bay. It offers EMSCULPT NEO® non-invasive body contouring, a medically supervised weight loss program, GLP-1 weight loss medication (Ozempic, Wegovy, Saxenda, Mounjaro) and Styku® 3D body scanning to track progress. Consultations are free.

- Address: The Shipyards Medical Arts Centre, 28 Huron St., Suite #201, Collingwood, Ontario L9Y 1C4, Canada (second floor)
- Phone: 705-888-2915
- Free consultation: https://theleansculptlab.ca/request-a-free-consultation
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theleansculptlab/
- Sister clinic: Georgian Bay Cosmetic Clinic (https://georgianbaycosmeticclinic.ca/)

## Services

- [EMSCULPT NEO®](https://theleansculptlab.ca/emsculpt-neo): FDA-cleared, non-invasive 30-minute treatment from BTL Aesthetics that combines HIFEM+ (high-intensity focused electromagnetic) energy with radiofrequency to reduce fat and build muscle. Clinical studies report an average 30% reduction in subcutaneous fat and a 25% increase in muscle volume. No downtime.
- [Physician-led weight loss program](https://theleansculptlab.ca/diet-plan): Medically supervised program with an initial physician assessment, personalized plan, nutrition guidance, exercise recommendations, behavioural support, regular monitoring and education.
- [GLP-1 weight loss medication](https://theleansculptlab.ca/diet-plan#glp): Ozempic, Wegovy, Saxenda and Mounjaro combined with lifestyle changes and regular follow-ups.
- [Monitoring your transformation](https://theleansculptlab.ca/monitoring-your-transformation): Styku® 3D body scanner using infrared technology for precise body measurements and progress tracking, more accurate than bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA).

## Pricing and payment

- [Cost & insurance coverage](https://theleansculptlab.ca/cost-insurance-coverage): EMSCULPT NEO® typical protocol is 4 sessions per area at $850 per session, with price reductions when treating multiple body areas. Not covered by OHIP; some private health plans may cover it. Detailed receipts are provided for insurers.
- [Payment plans](https://theleansculptlab.ca/payment-plans): Financing through Beautifi, a Canadian financing provider, with quick approval that does not affect your credit score.

## Frequently asked questions

- [EMSCULPT NEO® FAQ](https://theleansculptlab.ca/emsculpt-faq): Candidates, what to expect during and after treatment, protocol, side effects, results timeline, safety and eligibility (pregnancy, IUDs, implants, tattoos, surgery).
